title: Heart's Whisper
description: A woman in a green Victorian dress sits at a wooden desk writing in a notebook with a red quill. A giant stylized mouth with metallic teeth emerges from a purple tiled wall behind her, releasing long flowing pink ribbons that wrap around the scene while she holds a glowing blue orb containing a realistic anatomical heart.
prompt: A surreal scene of a young woman with dark hair in an ornate green Victorian dress with white sleeves, sitting at a wooden desk writing with a red quill. Behind her a giant stylized open mouth with metallic teeth emerges from a purple mosaic tiled wall with floral patterns. Long flowing pink ribbons with heart motifs stream from the mouth and wrap around her. She holds a glowing blue orb containing a detailed anatomical heart. Framed pictures of anatomical hearts and a red rose hang on the wall. Moody atmospheric lighting, intricate details.
